name: – After § 1 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1b. Recalls that the US embargo against Cuba is illegal, extraterritorial and contrary to international law; recalls that the UN General Assembly voted against the embargo for the 33rd consecutive year in 2025, by 165 votes to 7, with 12 abstentions; calls for the EU and its Member States to go beyond their traditional support for the UN resolution and to translate that position into concrete diplomatic and economic action to bring the embargo to an end;
